title: Women's Dance Mom – Bun Tight, Wallet Empty Embroidered Zip Hoodie

headline: BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON.
inks: pink and cream on Black and Navy, raspberry and navy on Ash
layout_story: BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. runs above her in two lines and WALLET EMPTY. below in two lines of heavy soft serif capitals
layout_faq: BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. above the dance mom and WALLET EMPTY. below
chest: a small WALLET over EMPTY. wordmark in the same soft serif capitals as the back
warm2: chilly studio lobbies, competition weekends and the drive home with the dance bag
gift_line: for the dance mom who has paid for every costume and still smiles.
